title: Rashid Mushkani
description: Rashid Mushkani is an IVADO Postdoctoral Fellow at Université de Montréal and co-founder and CEO of Cocoon Lab, researching democratic AI governance, civic participation, and urban planning.
homeDescription: I am an IVADO Postdoctoral Fellow at Université de Montréal’s Faculty of Law, working with Catherine Régis on the AI Pluralism Index. My research asks who can shape an AI system’s criteria and challenge its public use. I work on democratic AI governance, civic participation, administrative accountability, pluralistic evaluation, and urban planning. I defended my Ph.D. on 24 August 2026 and am co-founder and CEO of Cocoon Lab, which develops AI tools for planning and building review.
